resume: Cold open : une main d'or trace une ligne dans le noir. Aube au Faubourg des Sables : Idriss, porteur de rang Sable, nourrit sa famille d'espoir. Sa mère tousse, sa sœur révise, sa grand-mère accorde sa kora. Un appel : raid de dernière minute.
intention: Installer le monde, la pauvreté, l'amour de la famille, le père absent (écharpe), la faiblesse d'Idriss. Terminer sur le départ vers le Sarab : la dernière fois qu'il sera « seulement » un porteur.

panels.scene: Total black screen. A single thin line of liquid gold ink slowly draws itself from left to right across the darkness.
panels.action: A thin golden ink line traced as if by an invisible hand in a black void. Nothing else.
panels.light: Pitch black with only the soft gold glow of the ink line.
panels.fr: Écran noir. Un trait d'encre d'or se trace seul.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Dans le Mandé, on dit : personne n'est écrit avant de naître.

panels.scene: The black void. The golden line becomes a horizon line under a dark sky.
panels.action: Extreme close-up of the gold ink line, now widening into a glowing horizon with tiny specks of gold dust.
panels.light: Gold glow in absolute darkness.
panels.fr: Le trait devient l'horizon d'un désert au tout petit matin.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Ni les rois… ni les sphinx… ni les dieux.

panels.scene: Dawn over the Sahelian megacity of Al-Wagadou on a bend of the Niger river: mud-brick and concrete rooftops, minarets, a distant cluster of tall towers (the Tours du Soleil) made of mud-brick-style and glass, mist rising from the river.
panels.action: Sweeping wide view of the city waking up, golden horizon line becoming the real horizon, birds flying, smoke from cooking fires.
panels.light: Soft orange and pink dawn, long shadows, warm ochre and terracotta tones.
panels.fr: Aube sur Al-Wagadou. Plan d'ensemble de la ville au bord du fleuve.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Al-Wagadou, 2049. Trente et un ans après le premier mirage.

panels.scene: Faubourg des Sables: a poor neighborhood of narrow dusty lanes and small mud-brick houses with corrugated roofs, laundry lines, a donkey cart, a rooster on a wall.
panels.action: Rooftop-level view of the lanes beginning to stir; a rusty Diwan poster 'Rejoignez les Éveillés' peeling off a wall.
panels.light: Warm pink light, dust in the air.
panels.fr: Le quartier pauvre où vit Idriss.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Ici, on ne rêve pas de pouvoirs. On rêve de loyers payés.

panels.scene: Interior of a tiny mud-brick bedroom: a thin mat on the floor, a cracked ceiling, a small window letting in dawn light, an indigo scarf hanging on a nail.
panels.action: Idriss lies on a floor mat (no jacket, no scarf, no necklace on him), eyes open, staring at the ceiling, awake before the alarm. No glyph on his hands, no gold in his eyes.
panels.light: Soft grey-pink dawn light from the window, cool shadows.
panels.fr: Idriss, les yeux ouverts, avant le réveil.

panels.scene: The nail on the wall holding a faded indigo scarf, with a cowrie shell necklace hanging below it.
panels.action: Extreme close-up of the faded indigo scarf and a leather cord with a white cowrie shell hanging from a nail, dust motes floating in a ray of light.
panels.light: Single beam of dawn light across the scarf.
panels.fr: L'écharpe indigo de son père et le cauri.

panels.scene: Same bedroom.
panels.action: Idriss sits up and ties the indigo scarf around his neck with a practiced ritual gesture, eyes soft, then puts on the cowrie necklace.
panels.light: Warm dawn light rising on his face.
panels.fr: Il noue l'écharpe, comme chaque matin.

panels.scene: Small family kitchen-living room: a clay stove, a low table, mismatched stools, a calendar with circled dates, a school bag.
panels.action: Mariam stands at the stove frying beignets, then coughs into her shawl, shoulders shaking; she quickly hides the shawl behind her back when she sees someone coming.
panels.light: Warm kitchen glow from the stove fire, soft smoke.
panels.fr: Mariam fait des beignets et tousse dans son châle.
panels.texte: MARIAM : (toux)… Ce n'est rien. La poussière du matin.

panels.scene: The kitchen doorway.
panels.action: Over Mariam's shoulder, Idriss stands in the doorway holding the scarf end, worried but smiling to hide it.
panels.light: Warm stove glow on his face.
panels.fr: Idriss voit tout, mais sourit quand même.
panels.texte: IDRISS : Tu as encore pris trop de commandes, Maman.

panels.scene: The living room corner with a low table covered in textbooks, a small oil lamp still lit from the night.
panels.action: Nour sits cross-legged with a pile of textbooks, round glasses sliding down her nose, scribbling with a pencil, a half-eaten piece of bread beside her.
panels.light: Mix of dawn light and the oil lamp glow.
panels.fr: Nour révise avant l'école.
panels.texte: NOUR : Tu es encore parti sans manger hier soir. Compte les dinars, mais compte aussi les repas.

panels.scene: Same corner.
panels.action: Nour looks up over her glasses with a worried, sharp look, pencil frozen mid-line.
panels.light: Soft golden light on her round glasses.
panels.fr: Nour regarde son frère, inquiète.
panels.texte: NOUR : Les frais du lycée tombent vendredi.

panels.scene: Same living room.
panels.action: Idriss crouches next to his sister and gently ruffles her braids with a tired smile; she pretends to be annoyed.
panels.light: Warm, intimate light.
panels.fr: Idriss rassure sa sœur.
panels.texte: IDRISS : Je m'en occupe. Toi, tu étudies. C'est ton boulot.

panels.scene: A corner of the room by a window: a traditional kora leaning on the wall.
panels.action: Yaye Binta sits on a low stool tuning her kora, fingers plucking strings, eyes closed in joy, a faint smile.
panels.light: Soft window light making the calabash glow.
panels.fr: Yaye Binta accorde sa kora.

panels.scene: Same corner.
panels.action: Binta opens one eye and looks straight toward the viewer (toward Idriss) with a knowing, gentle, slightly mysterious smile.
panels.light: Warm side light on her wrinkles.
panels.fr: Binta le regarde avec une lueur de savoir.
panels.texte: BINTA : Mon petit porteur. Les anciens disent : le jour où l'on ne s'y attend pas…

panels.scene: The family table with a small pile of coins and crumpled notes.
panels.action: Idriss counts a small stack of dinar coins on the table with focused worry, moving them from one pile to another: rent, medicine, school.
panels.light: Warm sunbeam falling on the coins.
panels.fr: Il compte les dinars.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Loyer. Pharmacie. Lycée. Il manquait toujours la même chose : du temps.

panels.scene: The table.
panels.action: Extreme close-up of a cheap phone vibrating on the table among the coins, screen lighting up with an incoming call.
panels.light: Cold blue phone glow in warm morning light.
panels.fr: Le téléphone vibre.

panels.scene: Same kitchen-living room.
panels.action: Idriss answers the phone, his expression changing to attentive; Mariam in the background pauses with a beignet in tongs.
panels.light: Warm room light, phone glow on his chin.
panels.fr: Appel du contremaître.
panels.texte: CONTREMAÎTRE (au téléphone) : Idriss ? Un porteur a lâché. Raid à Gao-Nord, rang Cuivre. Quarante dinars. Départ dans une heure.

panels.scene: Same.
panels.action: Idriss hesitates, jaw tight, glancing toward his mother, then toward the stack of coins.
panels.light: Warm light on one side of his face, cool phone glow on the other.
panels.fr: Il hésite : c'est dangereux, mais il a besoin d'argent.
panels.texte: IDRISS : (bas) Un Sarab de rang Cuivre pour un Sable… ça sent mauvais.

panels.scene: Same.
panels.action: Mariam walks to him and places her thin hand on his cheek, forcing a bright smile through her tired eyes.
panels.light: Warm kitchen light.
panels.fr: Mariam le pousse à y aller.
panels.texte: MARIAM : Va. Le travail ne tombe pas du ciel. Reviens-moi entier, c'est tout.

panels.scene: Same.
panels.action: Extreme close-up of Mariam's thin hand pressing his scarf end back against his chest.
panels.light: Soft warm light.
panels.fr: Sa main sur l'écharpe.

panels.scene: The doorway of the house, morning light pouring in, the lane outside.
panels.action: Nour runs to the door and tucks a small wrapped beignet into Idriss's jacket pocket, scolding him with a frown.
panels.light: Bright white-gold morning light from the lane.
panels.fr: Nour glisse un beignet dans sa poche.
panels.texte: NOUR : Mange-le. Sinon je le dis à Binta.

panels.scene: Same doorway, seen from outside.
panels.action: Binta stands at the doorframe leaning on her kora, calling out to him with a strange serious tone.
panels.light: Backlit by the interior, soft rim light.
panels.fr: Binta murmure quelque chose d'étrange.
panels.texte: BINTA : Idriss. Reviens avec ton nom entier.

panels.scene: The lane outside.
panels.action: Idriss turns his head back toward the house with a puzzled half-smile, scarf end fluttering in the morning breeze.
panels.light: Warm morning sunlight, golden rim on his curly hair.
panels.fr: Il se retourne, intrigué par la phrase.
panels.texte: IDRISS : (sourire) Toujours des énigmes, Yaye.

panels.scene: The Faubourg des Sables lanes at full morning life: stalls, children with schoolbags, a donkey cart, women with baskets on their heads, a mobile phone vendor.
panels.action: Idriss, small in the frame, walks through the busy lane, a simple porter among hundreds of people.
panels.light: Bright warm morning, dust haze, ochre and terracotta tones.
panels.fr: Il traverse le quartier.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Un porteur de rang Sable. Le dernier échelon. Celui qu'on paie pour ne pas se battre.

panels.scene: A wall plastered with old torn posters in the lane.
panels.action: Idriss slows down in front of an old faded poster of a missing Awakened hunter: a smiling bearded man in a sand-colored coat (Moussa), the words unreadable.
panels.light: Soft shade, dust beams.
panels.fr: Il passe devant l'affiche de son père disparu.

panels.scene: The poster.
panels.action: Extreme close-up of a faded printed poster showing a smiling 38-year-old West African man with a short black beard, high cheekbones, warm deep brown skin, wearing a sand-colored coat and a faded indigo scarf (the missing hunter Moussa Keïta, same face structure as Idriss); a corner of the poster peeling.
panels.light: Dusty sunlight.
panels.fr: Le visage de Moussa sur l'affiche.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Moussa Keïta. Éveillé de rang Or. Disparu depuis douze ans.

panels.scene: Same wall.
panels.action: Idriss touches his own scarf, eyes soft with an old unhealed wound, then looks away and keeps walking.
panels.light: Soft shade with a warm edge.
panels.fr: Il touche l'écharpe, puis repart.

panels.scene: A sudden flashback panel, pale and washed out.
panels.action: Flashback: a laughing 38-year-old West African father (fit, short black beard, high cheekbones, warm deep brown skin, long sand-colored coat) crouches and ties a faded indigo scarf around the neck of his small 12-year-old son (thin boy, short curly black hair, a small crescent-shaped scar on his left eyebrow, tearful but brave smile); mostly empty pale background.
panels.light: Pale warm sepia tones with soft overexposure.
panels.fr: Flashback : le père noue l'écharpe à Idriss enfant.
panels.texte: MOUSSA : Porte-la jusqu'à mon retour, fiston.

panels.scene: The main road at the edge of the Faubourg, with buses and motorbike taxis.
panels.action: Idriss wipes his eyes quickly with his sleeve, shakes his head to clear it, and jumps onto the back of a motorbike taxi.
panels.light: Bright white-gold daylight.
panels.fr: Il s'essuie les yeux et prend un moto-taxi.

panels.scene: A bridge over the Niger with the city skyline and the Tours du Soleil in the background, boats on the river.
panels.action: Wide shot of the motorbike taxi crossing the bridge, Idriss a tiny figure; the Tours du Soleil glow ahead.
panels.light: Golden hour-like warm light on the river.
panels.fr: Il traverse le pont vers les Tours du Soleil.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Les Tours du Soleil. Le Diwan des Éveillés. Là où l'on pèse les hommes.

panels.scene: The foot of the sixty-floor Diwan tower, with the entrance plaza and a giant cowrie-shaped emblem above the doors.
panels.action: Dramatic low-angle shot of the Tours du Soleil towering above, Awakened hunters in shining armor walking in and out like celebrities.
panels.light: Brilliant sunlit glass and mud-brick-style facade.
panels.fr: Les Tours du Soleil écrasent la place.

panels.scene: The plaza in front of the tower, crowds of hunters.
panels.action: Idriss walks across the plaza with his head slightly bowed, ignored by everyone; hunters in gleaming armor pass by without seeing him, one shoulder-bumping him.
panels.light: Bright harsh sun, hard shadows.
panels.fr: Personne ne le voit.
panels.texte: HUNTER (au passage) : Pousse-toi, le porteur !

panels.scene: A departure yard beside the tower with an armored Diwan bus and raid gear.
panels.action: Idriss joins a small raid team gathering by a bus: a stern captain with a clipboard, a kind healer woman, and a smirking armored man (describe as unnamed extras).
panels.light: Bright daylight.
panels.fr: Il rejoint l'équipe de raid.

panels.scene: Beside the bus.
panels.action: Brahim Cissé, arms crossed, smirks at Idriss, looking him up and down; Idriss avoids his eyes.
panels.light: Hard midday light on Brahim's gold chain.
panels.fr: Brahim le raille.
panels.texte: BRAHIM : Tiens, notre mule. Essaie de ne pas pleurer quand on arrivera.

panels.scene: Beside the bus.
panels.action: Idriss smiles politely and says nothing, but his hand tightens on the scarf end.
panels.light: Soft shade.
panels.fr: Il serre l'écharpe et se tait.

panels.scene: The bus door.
panels.action: A captain with a clipboard (Captain Sidibé, tall, calm, scarred jaw, steel-grey armor) checks Idriss's name on a list and nods gruffly.
panels.light: Bright daylight.
panels.fr: Le capitaine Sidibé coche son nom.
panels.texte: SIDIBÉ : Keïta, Idriss. Porteur. Sable. (il lève les yeux) Reste derrière. Ne touche à rien.

panels.scene: Inside the bus, windows showing the Sahel landscape.
panels.action: Idriss sits on the last bench by a window, holding the wrapped beignet in his lap, smiling a little as he unwraps it.
panels.light: Warm window light, dust motes.
panels.fr: Il mange le beignet de Nour.

panels.scene: Bus window.
panels.action: Extreme close-up of the bus window reflecting Idriss's face while the landscape scrolls by: dry savanna, baobab silhouettes.
panels.light: Warm gold light, reflections.
panels.fr: Le paysage défile derrière son reflet.

panels.scene: A dry savanna plain under a hot sky, the bus a tiny dot on a dirt road.
panels.action: Wide shot of the road leading toward a vertical shimmering distortion in the air on the horizon, a Sarab (mirage-portal), tall as a building, its air rippling like water.
panels.light: Hot yellow sky, shimmer.
panels.fr: À l'horizon, le Sarab de Gao-Nord scintille.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Ce matin-là, il ne savait pas encore que ce serait la dernière fois qu'il porterait pour les autres.

panels.scene: Inside the bus.
panels.action: Idriss lifts his head and stares at the distant mirage through the bus window, a flicker of unease crossing his tired eyes.
panels.light: Hard shimmering light on his face.
panels.fr: Il fixe le mirage avec un frisson.

panels.scene: Idriss's eye.
panels.action: Extreme close-up of Idriss's dark eye reflecting the shimmering mirage; a tiny hint of gold flickers in the reflection (only the reflection).
panels.light: Dark eye, a tiny gold glint.
panels.fr: Dans son œil, une lueur d'or presque invisible.

panels.scene: Black screen again.
panels.action: A solid black page with, at the very bottom, the same thin golden ink line resuming its movement, drawing a short curve like the start of a letter.
panels.light: Black with a gold line.
panels.fr: Fin : l'encre d'or reprend son trait.
panels.texte: (Récitatif) Ce jour-là, son nom n'était écrit nulle part.
